project_meta.title: FinOps Monte Carlo Framework for Enterprise Data Investment Decisions
project_meta.author: Aditya Sumbaraju
project_meta.description: Multi-cloud data pipeline investment analysis with Gaussian copulas for correlated uncertainty

simulation.notes: 8% WACC applied as proper discount rate over a 3-year horizon (NPV-based ROI).

demand_volume.description: Daily transaction volume across a large enterprise pipeline (e.g., 10 million records/day)

unit_cost_usd.source: Public cloud pricing (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake, AWS on-demand rates)

compute_cost_usd_per_unit.description: Compute resource cost per record (/bin/bash.42 per 1,000 records => /bin/bash.00042/record). Annual base cloud spend = demand_per_day * 365 * compute_cost (~.5M/year at 10M records/day).

correlation_matrix.description: Gaussian copula correlation structure preserving observed covariance
correlation_matrix.notes: Demand-compute cost correlation 0.62; demand-utilization 0.55. Ignoring these correlations underestimates ROI variance.

capacity_expansion.name: Scenario A: Pipeline Capacity Expansion
capacity_expansion.description: Expanding cloud infrastructure (BigQuery slots, Snowflake credits, EC2 capacity)

benefits.rationale: Fixed capacity-cost savings (bulk pricing, reserved capacity) plus a demand-linked component reflecting variable compute-cost exposure during peak load.
benefits.calibration_note: Fixed component (capacity-cost savings via reserved capacity / bulk pricing) plus a demand-linked component (~0.35% of annual cloud spend) capturing variable compute-cost exposure during peak load. Component values are illustrative, calibrated to achieve the reported Table V means and SDs for a representative enterprise pipeline benchmark.

automation.name: Scenario B: ETL Reconciliation Automation
automation.description: Automate manual data quality checks and reconciliation

benefits.rationale: Predominantly fixed labor savings (FTE reduction) plus a small demand-linked dispute-recovery term. Cost structure is largely volume-invariant, producing a narrow ROI distribution.
benefits.calibration_note: Fixed labor-savings component (FTE reduction) plus a small demand-linked dispute-recovery term (~0.08% of cloud spend). Cost structure is largely volume-invariant, producing a narrow ROI distribution. Illustrative calibrated values.

governance.name: Scenario C: Multi-Cloud Governance Tooling
governance.description: Centralized anomaly detection and contract enforcement

benefits.rationale: Risk-avoidance benefit (expected compliance/penalty exposure reduction) plus a demand-linked compute-efficiency term. Medium variance reflects mixed fixed and demand-sensitive returns.
benefits.calibration_note: Fixed risk-avoidance component (expected compliance/penalty exposure reduction) plus a demand-linked compute-efficiency term (~0.31% of cloud spend). Illustrative calibrated values.

analysis.wacc_note: The 8% ROI threshold corresponds to a weighted average cost of capital typical of mid-market enterprise cloud infrastructure investments.

sensitivity_analysis.comment: Test ranking stability under correlation and data-quality uncertainty.
